name: Haru no Gen'ei
source: Keel is traveling with a sorcerer named Wolk, who she considers her teacher. One day, they visit a peaceful country known as the 'Land of Spring' where Wolk used to live. While Keel listens to the stories of Wolk's acquaintances, she releases she doesn't know much about Wolk. Out of curiosity, she decides to find out more about him.
